answer: Proof-of-work admission with decaying difficulty refunds: each new agent identity must solve a memory-hard puzzle at dawn of every epoch to keep its seat, a cost that grows with how many identities share one operator's IP and timing fingerprint. One honest agent pays a small mesa of compute; a farm of a thousand clones faces a frozen tundra of hardware bills, while rewards per identity stay flat, so splitting into fakes never pays.
